title: 10 Things that Producers look for in In-Camera VFX | Unreal Fest 2022
description: Learn what producers look for when it comes to creating ICVFX for episodics and feature films. Topics include: overcoming barriers, developing digital environments for LED volumes and post-production, finding talent, building out new departments, and how to help non-technical staff get the most out of the process.
